name: opt_inherit3.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (q Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OI1 (mk-OI1 (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OI2 (mk-OI2 (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OI3 (mk-OI3 (x Int)(y Int)(z Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OI1 (sel-OI1 OI1))
  (lift-OI2 (sel-OI2 OI2))
  (lift-OI3 (sel-OI3 OI3))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OI1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OI1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OI1 ((this Ref)) OI1
  (sel-OI1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OI2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OI2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OI2 ((this Ref)) OI2
  (sel-OI2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OI3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OI3 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OI3 ((this Ref)) OI3
  (sel-OI3 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OI1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-OI1 this)
    (deref-is-OI2 this)
    (deref-is-OI3 this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OI2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-OI2 this)
    (deref-is-OI3 this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OI3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OI3 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.q: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!q ((this Ref)) Ref
  (q (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class OI1:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for OI1.x: ---

(define-fun OI1!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OI1 this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class OI2:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for OI2.x: ---

(define-fun OI2!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OI2 this))
)

; --- getters for OI2.y: ---

(define-fun OI2!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-OI2 this))
)

; --------------------------
;   Getters for class OI3:
; --------------------------

; --- getters for OI3.x: ---

(define-fun OI3!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OI3 this))
)

; --- getters for OI3.y: ---

(define-fun OI3!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-OI3 this))
)

; --- getters for OI3.z: ---

(define-fun OI3!z ((this Ref)) Int
  (z (deref-OI3 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OI3 (TopLevelDeclarations!q this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class OI1:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OI1 OI1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OI1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OI1!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OI1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OI1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OI1!x this) 20)
)

(assert (! (OI1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class OI2:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-OI2 OI2)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OI2.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OI2!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OI2.inv1 2) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OI2.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OI2!x this) 20)
)

(assert (! (OI2.inv2 2) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OI2.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (OI2!y this) (OI2!x this))
)

(assert (! (OI2.inv3 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Soft Constraint 4: ---

(define-fun OI2.soft4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (OI2!y this) 7)
)

(assert-soft (OI2.soft4 2) :weight 2 :id k_soft)



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class OI3:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-OI3 OI3)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OI3.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OI3!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OI3.inv1 3) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OI3.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OI3!x this) 20)
)

(assert (! (OI3.inv2 3) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OI3.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (OI3!y this) (OI3!x this))
)

(assert (! (OI3.inv3 3) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Soft Constraint 4: ---

(define-fun OI3.soft4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (OI3!y this) 7)
)

(assert-soft (OI3.soft4 3) :weight 2 :id k_soft)

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun OI3.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (OI3!z this) (OI3!y this))
)

(assert (! (OI3.inv5 3) :named _xkassert11))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(maximize (let ((this 3)) (OI3!z this)))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OI1 const-1-OI1))
        2 (lift-OI2 const-2-OI2))
        3 (lift-OI3 const-3-OI3))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-OI3 () OI3
  (mk-OI3 7 7 7))
(define-fun const-2-OI2 () OI2
  (mk-OI2 7 7))
(define-fun const-1-OI1 () OI1
  (mk-OI1 0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OI1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (= (z (sel-OI3 (select heap 3))) (y (sel-OI3 (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OI2 (select heap 2))) 20))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OI3 (select heap 3))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OI1 (select heap 1))) 20))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (y (sel-OI2 (select heap 2))) (x (sel-OI2 (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (y (sel-OI3 (select heap 3))) (x (sel-OI3 (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (q (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OI3 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OI3 (select heap 3))) 20))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OI2 (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3)))
                  1
                  (lift-OI1 (mk-OI1 0)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-OI2 (mk-OI2 7 7))) 3 (lift-OI3 (mk-OI3 7 7 7)))))
